steps.content: You push open the door to find Ragnar curled up on the bed, his back toward you, his body trembling uncontrollably.
You take a few steps forward and hear him muttering under his breath, spitting out meaningless syllables.
As you get closer, you notice traces of dried black ooze still clinging to his skin. Your heart clenches with dread.
Then, the slime begins to move. Tiny tendrils writhe and squirm, like the feelers of some deep-sea creature.
Ragnar's delirious murmurs grate on some unbearably jarring frequency. You feel an inexplicable pain in your skull, but you can't tear your eyes away.
Shin's calm voice jolts you from your trance. When you look back at Ragnar, the black slime and maddening murmurs are gone.
You shake your head hard, trying to clear that strange feeling from your mind.
